business_summary: Nuveen New York Quality Municipal Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Nuveen Investments, Inc. The fund is co-managed by Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC and Nuveen Asset Management, LLC. It invests in the fixed income markets of New York. The fund invests in municipal bonds, with a rating of Baa or higher. It employs fundamental analysis, with bottom-up stock picking approach, to create its portfolio. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Standard & Poor's New York Municipal Bond Index and Standard & Poor's National Municipal Bond Index. The fund was formerly known as Nuveen New York Dividend Advantage Municipal Fund. Nuveen New York Quality Municipal Income Fund was formed on May 26, 1999 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Nuveen New York Quality Municipal Income Fund는 Nuveen Investments, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC와 Nuveen Asset Management, LLC가 공동 관리합니다. 뉴욕 채권시장에 투자합니다. Baa등급 이상의 지방채에 투자하는 펀드입니다. 포트폴리오를 생성하기 위해 상향식 주식 선택 접근 방식을 갖춘 기본 분석을 사용합니다. 이 펀드는 Standard & Poor의 New York Municipal Bond Index 및 Standard & Poor의 National Municipal Bond Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. 이 펀드는 이전에는 Nuveen New York Dividend Advantage Municipal Fund로 알려졌습니다. Nuveen New York Quality Municipal Income Fund는 1999년 5월 26일에 결성되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
